solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id,
       MIN(booked_at) AS first_booked,
       MAX(booked_at) AS last_booked
FROM shipments
WHERE booked_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND booked_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-02-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY customer_id;

rules.howSolved: Added booked_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' in the WHERE clause.
Used MIN(booked_at) as first_booked and MAX(booked_at) as last_booked.
Filtered before grouping, so only customers with a shipment in the range appear.

notes: The nulls and boundary datasets contain a booking at exactly 2026-02-01 00:00:00 UTC, so the exclusive upper bound matters there. Explicit +00 offsets avoid any dependence on the session time zone. Row counts per dataset: sample=6, nulls=5, boundary=5. Ran on every listed dataset without error.
